run_upload_benchmark_results: run the CLI to upload protobuf benchmark results from multiple language files to BigQuery
run_get_metadata: run get_metadata to collect CI build number, job name, and git commit from environment variables
run_upload_result: run upload_result to insert a list of benchmark throughput results into a BigQuery table
review_get_metadata: review get_metadata to understand how CI environment variables are collected into a metadata dictionary
review_upload_result: review upload_result to see how benchmark results are formatted and inserted into BigQuery with labels
